name: moi-workspace
title_zh: 聊天框里直接长出的工作台，小部件随叫随到
tagline_zh: 不用切窗口，在对话里让 Agent 给你造小部件、改主题、调布局。它先读懂你藏在消息里的 moi 暗号。
tagline_en: Skip the tab-switching: ask in plain chat and get widgets, themes, and layout tweaks built into the very UI.
desc_en: The moi workspace — the web UI the user chats from, extended with agent-authored applets (widgets, views) plus theme & config. Read this FIRST when a message carries a hidden moi-context envelope or the user uses moi vocab such as workspace, applet, widget, view, scratchpad, dashboard, or a `moi` command, or asks to build, edit, customize, or theme the workspace UI or its layout.
why_zh: 别的 skill 改文件，它改的是你正在用的聊天界面本身——Agent 写的 applet 直接变成你…
why_en: Other skills edit files; this one edits the live chat UI you're using. Agent-authored applets become views you see instantly—a.
limit_zh: 只认 moi 工作台环境（molefrog/moi 的 web UI）。
limit_en: Only works inside the moi workspace (molefrog/moi web UI). Won't act unless a message carries moi-context or uses workspace/applet vocab. Alters UI.
title_en: A workspace that grows applets right inside your chat
